get.summary: get a list of visits by odata query options
get.description:
Be aware that a query made here can return up to 10000 records. If you need more, please use the built in paging functionality with $top and $skip.
http://www.asp.net/web-api/overview/odata-support-in-aspnet-web-api/supporting-odata-query-options.
The provided searchString will result in a fulltext search on all selected fields. If the passed value is encapsulated with quotes("), it will be treated as an exact match search, otherwise the passed value will be an OR search over all keywords(splitted by space character).

parameters.name: searchString
parameters.description: Fulltext search on all string, int and date fields that are selected with $select.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: adds total possible results to the response

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: skips the first x entries of the response(paging)

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: limits the number of returned records.

get.summary: get the data of visits and associated visitors in csv format with fields separated by semicolon
get.description: get the data of visits and associated visitors in csv format with fields separated by semicolon

parameters.name: isUpcoming
parameters.description: The state of the visit is upcoming. Only one of the three states may be set true

parameters.name: isOngoing
parameters.description: The state of the visit is ongoing. Only one of the three states may be set true

parameters.name: isPast
parameters.description: The state of the visit is past. Only one of the three states may be set true

parameters.name: visitStartTimeFrom
parameters.description: The minimal start date/time of the visit. E.g. 2017-01-01

parameters.name: visitStartTimeTo
parameters.description: The maximal start date/time of the visit. E.g. 2017-01-31

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The list of the fields to return (comma separated list of fieldId from fieldConfiguration. Fields which do not match fieldConfiguration or are not authorized are not applied). Usable fields are e.g. Visits_StartTime, Visits_EndTime, Visitors_FirstName, Visitors_LastName

schema.default: StartTime, EndTime, Location, Info, FullName, Company, HostFirstName, HostLastName

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The location Id of the visit
